# Android ADB Control

Control an authorised Android phone or emulator through ADB with a perceive-reason-act-verify loop: fresh UI XML and/or screenshots, one device-changing action at a time, bounded settling and verification (default 30 actions / 5 minutes). Taps, swipes, text entry, app and Intent launch, bounded list traversal, captures pulled to a private host temp folder — with explicit scope required for any send, call, purchase, deletion, install, personal-data export or settings change, and no bypass of lock screen, biometrics, MFA or work-profile policy. Requires host shell access, adb (Android SDK Platform-Tools) and an authorised device; screenshots/XML the agent reads may go to its model provider.
